title: TRINITY isotope DeltaBvib acquisition
summary: Acquire isotope-specific DeltaBvib from independent composite energies and gradients or transform one complete parent cubic field acquired from analytic Hessians.
gates: frozen v4 composite reference Hessian and stationary gradient
independent resident GFN2 SCF at every displaced point
isotope-specific Wilson GF modes for energy-gradient stencils
complete parent cubic field with B/B-prime isotope transformation for Hessian stencils
two-step derivative convergence and explicit input fingerprints
coordinate_policy: Use frozen SMITH nonredundant primitives for the parent field and isotope-specific Wilson GF modes; never transform an incomplete semidiagonal cubic field between isotopologues.
backend_policy: LINK evaluates resident GFN2-XTB plus Delta(ZAFF) v4 with an independent SCF state per point; TRINITY assembles the requested derivatives and isotope corrections.
